The '''Solaest Fleet Long Range Patrol Wing''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]]. [[Flight Captain]] [[T. Alvak]] served in the unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWS" />
